name: Lara
source: A higly ambitious and meticulous single mother striving to become the main TV anchor, Lara thrives on challenges and exploration. Despite her stron-willed nature, she struggles to handle her rebellious daughter, Angelica, and secretly harbors suppressed desires she refuses to acknowledge.
